intro: The Heart of Isha Awak is taken from the mighty thresher known as Isha Awak, the Deep Doom of the Merchant Coast. Sought by the tauren seer Mahren Skyseer, it serves as proof of overcoming one of the ocean's most formidable predators.

p: Off the sun-drenched shores of the Merchant Coast south of Ratchet dwells Isha Awak, a massive sea beast revered and feared by sailors and coastal inhabitants alike. Known as the Deep Doom, the creature has claimed the lives of numerous human trespassers along the shoreline. For the mystic Mahren Skyseer, however, the beast represents an honorable predator rather than a mindless menace. She believes Isha Awak's fierce spirit resides directly within its heart, charging brave hunters to plunge into the waves, best the beast in its domain, and claim the pulsating organ as both trophy and spiritual offering.
